name: 911 Remove Ticket
description: Removes PART SKETCH pages from nest package PDFs, saving output as '{name} Move Ticket Omit.pdf' in a Move Ticket Omit subfolder. Stamps the first page with BATCH: / NEST: (red Century Gothic, under Quality Requirements), a colour-coded SIMPLE / MEDIUM / DIFFICULT difficulty label read from the EB 922 Schedule, and fills the blank Material Type cell from the removed move tickets. Originals are untouched.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the folder of nest PDFs ready (usually a NEST PACKAGES folder). You can pick it each run or set it in Settings.
Keep the standard '{batch} / NEST PACKAGES' folder layout so the batch and nest fill into the cover stamp automatically.
how_it_works: Pick the PDF folder and choose which PDFs to process (or all of them).
Each PDF loses its MOVE TICKET pages - MIL-SPEC and HULL pages are always kept.
The first page is stamped 'BATCH {batch} - NEST {nest}', and the blank Material Type cell is filled from the move tickets before they're removed.
output: A '{name} Move Ticket Omit.pdf' for each PDF, saved in a 'Move Ticket Omit' subfolder. Your originals are never changed.

fields.label: PDF Directory
fields.description: Folder containing the nest package PDFs to process.
